name: io.github.bytebase/bytebase-mcp
title: Bytebase
description: Query, inspect, and change databases through Bytebase's governed workflow with audit logging.

environmentVariables.name: BYTEBASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: External URL of your Bytebase instance (e.g. https://bytebase.example.com). The package connects to <BYTEBASE_URL>/mcp and signs you in with the instance's OAuth.

environmentVariables.name: BYTEBASE_MCP_CALLBACK_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Loopback port that receives the OAuth redirect during sign-in (default: 51789)

environmentVariables.name: BYTEBASE_MCP_NO_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to print the sign-in URL instead of opening a browser
